# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My pick for most people: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W)**
- It charges at 25W with an active cooling fan, and it includes a 50W adapter. WIRED's travel guide noted a button to turn the fan off at night.
- It lists at $99.99. The Dealectric page says code PARTNER18 takes $17.99 off at ESR's store, for about $82, through 12/31/2026. They say they tested it in ESR's cart, but the store's checkout has the final word.
- 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- Buy: [ESR CryoBoost at ESR's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- WIRED also lists it at about $100 on Amazon: [WIRED travel chargers guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/).

**Other strong options**
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (best overall per WIRED):**
  - It charges at 15W and has a tilting pad. The pad works in landscape for StandBy mode, and the chrome design is sturdy.
  - It lists at $109, with WIRED showing $98 on sale, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Prices change, so check them.
  - [WIRED's best 3-in-1 guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) has the shop links.
- **Nomad Stand One Max (fastest, $169):**
  - It charges at 25W and has a premium glossy build. The base is heavy enough to lift your phone off with one hand.
  - It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one. WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W adapter for $25.
  - [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) has the details.
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99):**
  - Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It folds for travel and includes a 45W adapter.
  - [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W), best budget:**
  - WIRED saw it at about $40 on Amazon, down from $80. The Apple Watch charger is a detachable module.
  - [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Nimble Podium (about $130):** It lies flat so no screens glow at night, and it supports 25W. WIRED notes its Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Is 25W worth paying for?** Both WIRED and Macworld say the faster speed makes little difference if you charge overnight. If you have an iPhone 17 and want quick top-ups, the ESR CryoBoost is the cheapest 25W route. If you don't need that, the Belkin or the budget ESR will do the job.

I couldn't open retailer pages, so aside from the ESR link, the other links go to the review pages rather than direct purchase pages.
